title: Architect workspace: professional frontend, evidence, address search and map context
objective: Implement the owner-approved architect interface using existing canonical API contracts; preserve every material fact and trace; frontend only.
outputs: Professional architect shell and all available workflow screens; future view capability labels
Bounded source-backed autocomplete and map context; safe link and error handling
Complete facts/calculations/sources/review disclosures and printable brief of actual results
Executable behavior tests and producer evidence

acceptance_scenarios.input: Open address/BBL entry, choose lot, visit overview/facts/zoning/evidence/review/report
acceptance_scenarios.expected: Professional consistent navigation; primary result/map visible; each original fact, missing input, conflict and unsupported check accessible; no invented numbers

acceptance_scenarios.preconditions: Recorded official GeoSearch response plus existing address resolver

risks: Source service outage/CORS or inaccessible deployment credentials
Existing e2e selectors encode the prior UI; adapt user-journey navigation while retaining safety assertions
Some approved concept capabilities lack backend support; preserve unavailable state instead of fabrication
path_notes: New owner-authorized frontend task, independent of suspended expansion engines. M4-T005 is historical awaiting-G6 code, not an active writer per handoff seq112. No active writer overlaps this task.
Execution: ChatGPT cloud Linux workspace (29 GB free); temporary web dependencies/build/browser evidence under 2 GB expected, ignored from git. No owner-PC installation. CI authoritative.

Modularity: presentation belongs in small architect components and CSS; fetching/cancellation in dedicated hooks/clients. Preserve canonical clients, generated contracts, legal engine and public route bookmarks. New modules target under 600 SLOC; extract from oversized views rather than grow them.
Source introductions require G1/G5. GeoSearch suggestions are address candidates, not PLUTO facts; existing official resolver remains identity authority. Map context display does not evaluate zoning.
Future 3D/unit/financial capability screens are honest unavailable views, no engine or persistence work.

Independent D-061 intake corrected atomic tracking without scope change: R009 scope preservation, R010 autocomplete, R013 main/PR protection are additional task bindings. Deployment R008/R011/R012 remain separately tracked delivery acts.
